subject: Burst insurance credit and granular rate matrix
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@edgeapps.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term burst coverage request

Hi Naomi,

We're heading into an unplanned campaign next week and expect a 4x surge above our committed throughput for ~48 hours. We ran the projection and the projected overrun would push us past our committed headroom and create a substantial overage for October.

Before we scale our fallback, can Redwood provide (a) a priced short-term "burst insurance" credit (e.g., a pre-purchased overruns pool) and (b) a way to cap effective per-token rates during the surge so we don't spike our invoices?

We want something we can sign quickly — ideally a one-page amendment or SOW. Attached a brief usage snapshot.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
EdgeApps Inc.

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@edgeapps.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term burst coverage request

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can absolutely help and have two approaches that usually work:

1) Burst credit (pre-paid) — EdgeApps purchases an interim burst pool (e.g., $X upfront buys Y token headroom). Credits draw down over the surge window and reconcile at month-end.

2) True-up amendment with a temporary rate cap — we create a short amendment that sets a capped overrun per-token rate for a defined 48-hour window and applies an automatic prorated credit if usage exceeds a threshold.

I'll pull together a concise term-sheet for both options and include a sample DocuSign so you can choose quickly. Jordan — can you confirm preliminary pricing bands for a 48-hour, 4x spike (US region)? I also attached the usage CSV you sent for reference.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term burst coverage request

Naomi — quick note on pricing: for a one-off 48-hour window at 4x we can offer two graded options:

A) Burst Credit — sell a $40k credit that covers up to 60M extra tokens, effective for the specified window. Unused credit rolls into October balance as a one-time invoice offset.

B) Rate Cap + True-up — cap overrun rate at $0.012/token for the 48-hr window (versus standard overrun at $0.02/token), with a reconciliation true-up at month-end and a 10% service admin fee if usage exceeds the cap by more than 15%.

If EdgeApps needs contractual simplicity, option A executes faster; option B is cheaper if they are confident about the upper bound and want predictable per-token economics. Ben — are we comfortable approving a one-time 15% admin overrun condition?

—Jordan

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@edgeapps.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term burst coverage request

Naomi/Jordan — thank you for the options. EdgeApps prefers the Rate Cap + True-up (option B) because it keeps billing predictable for the campaign. Two asks before we sign:

- Can you lower the cap to $0.010/token if we commit to a small uplift in our monthly commitment after October? We plan to migrate an additional 2 services next quarter.
- Can the admin fee be replaced with a fixed flat-processing fee ($2,500) instead of percent-based?

We're ready to proceed quickly if we can get those two changes; we can sign the amendment via DocuSign within 24 hours.

Best,
Samira

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@edgeapps.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term burst coverage request

Samira — good news. Ben approved the modified terms with a minor concession: we can set the overrun cap at $0.010/token for the 48-hour window provided EdgeApps executes the attached amendment and commits to a 12% uplift in committed monthly tokens starting November for a minimum 3-month window. We will also replace the percentage admin charge with a flat $2,500 processing fee.

I've attached a one-page term-sheet (burst-insurance-term-sheet.pdf) and the DocuSign link; the DocuSign pre-fills the dates for the 72-hour candidate window and the uplift schedule. If you sign before EOD Monday we'll lock the cap and apply the $40k billing offset as discussed in the term-sheet.

Next steps:
- Review and sign the DocuSign (link below)
- We will provision the temporary rate cap and publish a one-time amendment to the billing console
- Jordan will coordinate on telemetry and a surge throttle guard to avoid accidental overdraws

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ae/sign/XYZ-EDGEAPPS-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/EA-2027-Q4-047

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
